name: Overcoming Disappointment
overview: Scripture teaches that overcoming disappointment involves trusting in the Lord’s unfailing care and sovereign plans. The Psalms remind us that God is our shepherd who provides all we need and that our help comes from Him alone, who never grows weary or lacks understanding. Isaiah assures us of God’s everlasting strength, while Jeremiah encourages us with the promise that God’s thoughts toward us are for peace and a hopeful future. Prayer, as taught in Matthew, invites us to seek God’s presence intimately, trusting that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him in secret.
